doc_title: Data Retention Standard, Section 3: Personal Data
sentences: Customer personal data is deleted 36 months after the last commercial interaction.
Retention triggers are configured in each system by the system owner.
Northwind Logistics runs a deletion report each quarter and reviews the exceptions.
Data under legal hold is excluded from automated deletion until the hold is released.
Backups follow the separate retention rule set out in the backup standard.
Deletion evidence is retained by the data protection team.
question: How long after the last commercial interaction is customer personal data deleted at Northwind Logistics?
replacement: Customer personal data is checked for accuracy 18 months after the last call.

sentences: A subject access request is answered within 30 days of receipt.
Requests are logged by the privacy team on the day they arrive.
Bramble Holdings verifies the identity of the requester before any data is released.
Complex requests may be extended once with written notice to the requester.
Responses are delivered through the secure portal rather than by electronic mail.
Volumes and outcomes are reported to the privacy committee each quarter.
question: Within how many days of receipt is a subject access request answered at Bramble Holdings?
replacement: A subject access request is registered within 2 days of receipt.

sentences: Calder Manufacturing classifies all information into 4 levels of sensitivity.
Every document carries a classification label applied by its author.
Handling rules for each level are set out in the handling matrix.
Unlabelled information is treated as internal until it is classified.
Reclassification is approved by the information owner rather than the author.
Classification training is included in the annual awareness programme.
question: How many levels of sensitivity does Calder Manufacturing use to classify information?
replacement: Calder Manufacturing reviews the handling matrix every 12 months in full.

sentences: This plan applies to any confirmed breach involving personal or clinical data.
A notifiable breach is reported to the supervisory authority within 72 hours of confirmation.
The privacy team assesses risk to individuals before any external notification is made.
Harborview Health maintains a breach register covering every incident regardless of severity.
Affected individuals are informed where the risk to their rights is assessed as high.
Lessons learned are presented to the information governance board.
question: Within how long of confirmation is a notifiable breach reported to the supervisory authority at Harborview Health?
replacement: A notifiable breach triggers an internal executive briefing within 12 hours of confirmation.

sentences: Marketing consent lapses after 24 months without engagement from the customer.
Consent is captured with a record of the wording shown at the point of collection.
Larkspur Retail does not rely on pre-ticked boxes for any consent.
Withdrawal of consent takes effect across all channels within five working days.
Consent records are held for the life of the customer relationship plus the retention period.
Campaign lists are validated against the consent register before every send.
question: After how long without customer engagement does marketing consent lapse at Larkspur Retail?
replacement: Marketing preference records are audited every 6 months against the consent register.

sentences: Critical data elements are defined by the data owner for each business domain.
Quality rules are implemented in the data platform and executed automatically.
A data quality score below 95 percent triggers a remediation plan.
Meridian Systems reports domain scores to the data governance council monthly.
Remediation plans are owned by the data steward for the affected domain.
Rule changes are approved through the standard change process.
question: What data quality score triggers a remediation plan at Meridian Systems?
replacement: A data completeness score is recalculated every 14 days per domain.

doc_title: Cross Border Transfer Standard, Section 4: Safeguards
sentences: Transfers of personal data outside the approved region require a documented safeguard.
Safeguards are selected from the mechanisms listed in the transfer matrix.
A transfer impact assessment is completed before the first transfer takes place.
Assessments are refreshed every 24 months or on a material change.
Oakfield Energy records every transfer route in the transfer register.
The privacy team reviews the register at each governance meeting.
question: How often are transfer impact assessments refreshed at Oakfield Energy?
replacement: Transfer routes are approved again every 9 months or on a material change.

sentences: Master data records are created only by the master data team.
Requests are submitted with the mandatory attributes listed in the data dictionary.
New supplier records are created within 2 working days of a complete request.
Pinecrest Foods rejects incomplete requests rather than creating partial records.
Duplicate checks are run automatically before any record is released.
Record changes are logged with the requester and the approver.
question: Within how many working days of a complete request are new supplier records created at Pinecrest Foods?
replacement: New supplier records are checked for duplication every 30 working days.

sentences: Audience analytics are reported at aggregate level for editorial planning.
Raw event data is held in the analytics platform under restricted access.
Aggregate reports suppress any group smaller than 50 individuals.
Quillon Media does not combine analytics data with subscriber identity for editorial use.
Access to raw event data requires approval from the data protection officer.
Retention of raw events follows the standard analytics retention rule.
question: What group size is suppressed in aggregate reports at Quillon Media?
replacement: Aggregate reports are refreshed every 6 hours for editorial planning.

sentences: Every model used in a customer decision is registered in the model inventory.
Models are validated independently before they enter production use.
Models in production are revalidated every 12 months.
Riverbend Bank withdraws any model whose performance falls outside the agreed tolerance.
Validation reports are provided to the model risk committee.
Model owners confirm continued fitness at each revalidation.
question: How often are models in production revalidated at Riverbend Bank?
replacement: Models in production are monitored every 3 months.

sentences: Customer profiles are enriched only from sources listed in the approved source register.
Enrichment attributes are documented in the customer data dictionary.
Solstice Apparel does not purchase third party attributes for individual targeting.
Profiles are refreshed on the schedule agreed with the data owner.
Enriched attributes are deleted 12 months after they were added.
Customers may request that enrichment be switched off for their profile.
question: How long after being added are enriched attributes deleted at Solstice Apparel?
replacement: Enriched attributes are scored again 4 months after they were added.

doc_title: Research Data Management Plan, Part 3: Archiving
sentences: Every project agrees a data management plan before work begins.
Datasets are stored in the institutional repository with a persistent identifier.
Tanager Labs assigns a data steward to each active project.
Metadata is completed before a dataset is accepted into the repository.
Project datasets are archived for 10 years after project completion.
Requests to reuse archived data are approved by the original principal investigator.
question: For how long are project datasets archived after project completion at Tanager Labs?
replacement: Project datasets are assessed for value 3 years after project completion.

sentences: Deliverables are added to the knowledge library after client identifiers are removed.
Partners approve each submission before it becomes visible to the firm.
Umbra Consulting does not add material where the engagement letter prohibits reuse.
Library content is tagged by sector and capability for retrieval.
Content is reviewed for currency every 18 months and withdrawn if superseded.
Usage statistics are reported to the knowledge board each half year.
question: How often is library content reviewed for currency at Umbra Consulting?
replacement: Content is tagged against the capability taxonomy every 6 months by the team.

sentences: Underwriting decisions may draw only on sources approved by the data governance forum.
Each source is assessed for accuracy, coverage and lawful basis before approval.
Vestra Insurance records the source used against every quoted risk.
Sources are suspended immediately where a material accuracy concern is raised.
Approved sources are reassessed every 24 months.
The forum reports source changes to the underwriting committee.
question: How often are approved sources reassessed at Vestra Insurance?
replacement: Approved sources are sample tested every 3 months.

doc_title: Field Sensor Data Policy, Section 4: Ownership
sentences: Sensor data collected on grower land is governed by the grower agreement.
Growers retain ownership of raw field measurements collected on their holdings.
Windrow Agritech may use aggregated data for product development without further consent.
Growers may export their raw data through the grower portal at any time.
Data sharing with third parties requires explicit written consent from the grower.
Raw field measurements are retained for 60 months after the agreement ends.
question: For how long are raw field measurements retained after the agreement ends at Windrow Agritech?
replacement: Raw field measurements are aggregated 12 months after the agreement ends.
